notes.subject: יחרוש בבקרים
notes.rationale: literally 'will one plow with oxen?' — some read 'plow the sea' (LXX) or 'plow there'; the impossibility-parallel with horses on rock is the point

notes.subject: לראש
notes.rationale: rosh is a named poisonous plant (poppy/gall); rendered 'pison' since Tok Pisin lacks a specific plant name

notes.subject: הירצון בסלע
notes.rationale: 'run upon the rock' (cliff) — could also be 'run against the crag', same impossible image

translation: Ol hos i ken ran long ston? O man i ken wokim gaden long ol bulmakau? Bikos yupela i senisim kot i kamap pison, na frut bilong tsedek i kamap bitterpela diwai bilong pison.

tokens.gloss: i kamap bitterpela diwai bilong pison
